About the Position

This UQ project investigates the use of large language models in Australian strata management. Research interests include foundation models and related data-driven methods. Applicants submit an expression of interest for the advertised project, which also provides the scholarship consideration route.

Research Areas

  • Large language models
  • Artificial intelligence
  • Data science

About University of Queensland

UQ offers postgraduate research through its schools and institutes, including the Institute for Molecular Bioscience. Its scholarship routes include university awards, named scholarships and funding attached to specific research projects.
